The '''Maxillipede shuttle''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] model used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
The vessel had a similar design to the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], but with two large dorsal fins instead of one.<ref name="SW" />

==History==
[[D-Squad's Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|One]] such craft was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and used to carry out a [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|mission]]. The leader of the mission was [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], and the crew was made up of several droids, who were called the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]]. The ship had [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] markings, and it was painted in the "traditional" Separatist [[Color/Legends|colors]] white and dark blue/purple. Another one was used by the CIS when they captured clone trooper [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] and brought him there captive, but the Republic rescued him and took the ship.<ref name="SW" />
